verdict.rationale: Multi-entity management and consolidated reporting are fair questions for a bookkeeping service, but the evidence only shows single-business income statements, balance sheets and P&L dashboards. Nothing documents managing several legal entities or consolidating financials across them. The Mainstreet "entity formation" mention concerns forming an entity, and banking "dedicated accounts" are sub-accounts within one business; both are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them
